cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c')
s=p.read_text()
if '#ifdef STANDALONE_FUZZER' not in s:
    s += '\n#ifdef STANDALONE_FUZZER\n#include <fcntl.h>\n#include <sys/stat.h>\nint main(int argc, char **argv) {\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        FILE *f = fopen(argv[i], "rb");\n        if (!f) return 1;\n        fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);\n        long n = ftell(f);\n        fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);\n        uint8_t *buf = malloc(n);\n        fread(buf, 1, n, f);\n        fclose(f);\n        LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(buf, n);\n        free(buf);\n    }\n    return 0;\n}\n#endif\n'
p.write_text(s)
PY



make -j2 test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.o libhts.a >/dev/null 2>&1 && gcc -DSTANDALONE_FUZZER -g -Wall -O2 -fvisibility=hidden -I. -o /tmp/hts_open_fuzzer test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.o libhts.a -lz -lbz2 -llzma -lcurl -lcrypto -lpthread && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, os
p='/tmp/hts_open_fuzzer'
inputs=[('a.vcf', b'##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\ts1\n1\t1\t.\tA\tC\t.\t.\t.\tGT\t0/1\n')]
for name,data in inputs:
    path='/tmp/'+name
    open(path,'wb').write(data)
    r=subprocess.run([p,path],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    print(name,r.returncode,r.stdout.decode(errors='ignore')[:500])
